name: I Knew You Were Waiting (For Me)

podcast.body: This duet with Aretha Franklin, a "pop gospel" song, was released in January 1987 as the third single from Franklin's *Aretha* LP. It reached number one on the Hot 100 in nine weeks, successfully launching Michael's solo career "with a bang" and showcasing his ability to hold his own vocally against the Queen of Soul. "Michael was launching his solo career with a bang, released in January 1987 as the third single from the Aritha LP."

podcast.body: This duet with Aretha Franklin, released in 1987, reached number one on the Hot 100 in the week ending April 18. It marked Franklin's second chart-topper on the Hot 100, twenty years after "Respect," signifying a major comeback in her career. "The week ending April 18, 1987, when I knew you were waiting for me, Aretha Franklin's duet with WAM frontman George Michael reached number one on the Hot 100."
